scale: 0 major meaning-changing/hard-to-follow failure; 1 understandable minor error or awkwardness; 2 clear consistent natural text
binary: sum>=8, min>0, no contradiction, no incoherent_sentence
clarifications: Narrative development and new characters allowed if plausibly connected. An implied problem need not be solved. Talking animals allowed when internally consistent. An unfinished final sentence alone is not a failure. Empty, wholly unrelated or context-ignoring repetition fails.
